q.zh: GDL 对象最终由什么生成？
q.en: What ultimately produces a GDL object?

explain.zh: GDL 是描述式的：脚本写清楚形体、符号和参数，Archicad 负责生成。改脚本即改对象，不需要重新建模。
explain.en: GDL is descriptive: scripts state the geometry, symbol and parameters, and Archicad generates the result. Change the script and the object changes — no remodelling.

q.zh: 对象在平面图上显示成什么样，由哪个脚本决定？
q.en: Which script decides how the object looks in plan?

explain.zh: 2D 脚本画平面符号，3D 脚本画三维形体，界面脚本只负责设置对话框。三者互相独立。
explain.en: The 2D script draws the plan symbol, the 3D script builds the solid, and the UI script only lays out the settings dialog. They are independent.

q.zh: 想让一个图库部件能被放进项目，前提是什么？
q.en: What must be true before a library part can be placed in a project?

zh: 它有正确的子类型并且所在图库已加载
它被编译成独立的可执行程序
en: It has the right subtype and its library is loaded
It has been compiled into a standalone program
It has been uploaded to the cloud

explain.zh: 子类型决定它能不能放在墙上、地上；图库没加载，项目里就找不到这个部件。
explain.en: The subtype decides whether it can go on a wall or the floor; if the library is not loaded, the project cannot find the part at all.

q.zh: `BLOCK 2, 0.6, 0.05` 这三个数分别表示什么？
q.en: What do the three numbers in `BLOCK 2, 0.6, 0.05` mean?

en: Sizes along X, Y and Z
The coordinates of the insertion point

explain.zh: BLOCK 的参数是长宽高，不是一个点。位置靠变换命令（ADD）决定，尺寸和位置是两件事。
explain.en: BLOCK takes width, depth and height — not a point. Position comes from transformation commands such as ADD; size and placement are separate concerns.

q.zh: GDL 的局部坐标系里，Z 轴指向哪里？
q.en: In the GDL local coordinate system, where does the Z axis point?

explain.zh: GDL 用 Z 轴向上的右手坐标系，画楼板、墙体时高度就是 Z。Three.js 里会映射成 Y 向上，那只是渲染层的换算。
explain.en: GDL uses a right-handed system with Z up, so heights go along Z. Three.js maps that to Y up — a renderer-level conversion only.

q.zh: 画完一个物体后再执行 `ADD 1, 0, 0`，下一个物体的位置会怎样？
q.en: After drawing one body you run `ADD 1, 0, 0`. Where does the next body go?

zh: 沿 X 轴偏移 1 米
沿 Z 轴抬高 1 米
en: 1 metre along X from the previous position

explain.zh: ADD 平移的是当前坐标系，之后画的物体都按新原点定位，直到 DEL 退回。
explain.en: ADD shifts the current coordinate frame; everything drawn afterwards uses the new origin until DEL pops it.

zh: 删除最后画的一个物体

explain.zh: DEL 是退栈，不是删除几何。常见误解之一：以为 DEL 会删掉物体，其实它只恢复上一层坐标系。
explain.en: DEL pops the stack — it does not delete geometry. A common misconception is that it removes bodies; it only restores the previous frame.

q.zh: 变换堆栈的出入顺序是？
q.en: In what order does the transformation stack work?

explain.zh: 和函数调用栈一样是后进先出：最后压入的变换最先被 DEL 弹出。压了几层就要退几层。
explain.en: It is last-in-first-out like a call stack: the most recently pushed frame is popped first. Push N levels, pop N levels.

q.zh: 循环里每轮都 ADD 却从不 DEL，最可能的后果是？
q.en: A loop calls ADD every iteration but never DEL. What is the likely result?

zh: 偏移量逐轮累加，物体越跑越远
en: Offsets accumulate and bodies drift away

explain.zh: 没有 DEL，上一轮的偏移会留给下一轮，位置层层叠加。要么循环内 DEL 退回，要么用绝对坐标。
explain.en: Without DEL the previous offset carries into the next iteration and stacks up. Either pop inside the loop or use absolute coordinates.

en: At the top of the 3D script
At the end of the UI script

explain.zh: 参数列表定义名称、类型、默认值与取值范围；脚本里只是使用它们，不能顺手新建参数。
explain.en: The parameter list defines name, type, default and range. Scripts only consume parameters — they cannot create new ones on the fly.

q.zh: 下面哪个是合法的参数类型？
q.en: Which of these is a valid parameter type?

explain.zh: GDL 参数类型包括长度、角度、整数、实数、字符串、布尔、材质等，没有「图层」这种类型；材质用索引号引用。
explain.en: GDL types include length, angle, integer, real, string, boolean and material — there is no layer type; materials are referenced by index.

q.zh: 改了参数值但模型没变化，最可能的原因是？
q.en: You change a parameter but the model does not move. Most likely cause?

zh: 脚本里根本没用到这个参数
en: The script never uses that parameter

explain.zh: 先搜脚本里有没有出现这个参数名。参数只是输入，不写进命令就不会有任何效果。
explain.en: Search the scripts for the parameter name first. A parameter is only an input — if no command uses it, nothing happens.

q.zh: 在平面图上画一条线段用哪个命令？
q.en: Which command draws a line segment in plan?

explain.zh: 二维命令都带 2 后缀：LINE2、ARC2、POLY2。LINE3 是三维线，BLOCK 是实体。
explain.en: 2D commands carry a 2 suffix: LINE2, ARC2, POLY2. LINE3 draws in 3D and BLOCK creates a solid.

zh: 平面图与剖面里的符号
en: The symbol in plan and section views

explain.zh: 2D 脚本只负责二维符号；三维形体由 3D 脚本负责，两者不要混着改。
explain.en: The 2D script only draws the 2D symbol; the 3D script owns the solid. Do not mix the two.

q.zh: 对象在平面图上完全看不到，最先该检查什么？
q.en: An object is invisible in plan. What should you check first?

explain.zh: 没有 2D 脚本就没有平面符号，这是最常见的原因；其次是图层与画笔颜色。
explain.en: No 2D script means no plan symbol — the usual culprit. Layer and pen colour come next.

q.zh: GDL 的 FOR 循环以什么结束？
q.en: How does a GDL FOR loop end?

explain.zh: FOR ... TO ... STEP ... NEXT；END 用于 IF / 宏等结构，RETURN 用于子程序返回。
explain.en: FOR ... TO ... STEP ... NEXT. END closes IF and similar blocks; RETURN leaves a subroutine.

q.zh: 用 GOSUB 调用子程序后，靠什么返回？
q.en: After calling a subroutine with GOSUB, what returns control?

explain.zh: GOSUB 跳到标签，执行到 RETURN 回到调用处；忘记 RETURN 会一路执行到脚本末尾并报错。
explain.en: GOSUB jumps to a label and RETURN comes back; forgetting RETURN runs to the end of the script and errors out.

q.zh: `IF cond THEN` 后面只写了一条语句，条件不成立时会怎样？
q.en: `IF cond THEN` is followed by a single statement. What happens when the condition is false?

zh: 跳过这一条，继续往下执行
en: That statement is skipped and execution continues

explain.zh: 单行 IF 只控制紧随其后的一条语句。要多条语句受控，用 IF ... THEN ... ENDIF 块。
explain.en: A single-line IF controls only the next statement. Wrap several statements in IF ... THEN ... ENDIF.
